svg.text: Leshy2 - five relaxed microcoax service corridors
Actual H6 footprint coordinates - one removable tape saddle per cable - ZIF and display slot stay accessible
UI PCB - inner face - antenna edge and upper service volume
T = 5 x 3 mm removable tape on clear PCB solder mask
S = same tape on the documented flat S3 shield; keep its rim clear
S3: native B-side connector below shield; gentle curve to upper U.FL
4.7 mm cable-height reservation includes shield, cable and tape
All five nominal curves: R >= 6 mm; Ebyte source-window forming
remains an explicit H6.0.7 check at the actual connector axes
DO NOT GUESS AN IPEX AXIS FOR THE THREE LONG PATHS
The Ebyte drawing puts IPEX in one corner but gives no centre dimension.
Dashed source windows enclose that entire published corner.
Length is checked from the farthest window point, not the drawn dot.
Continuity-check and mate both ends vertically.
Form a visible relaxed bow; never pull on a plug.
Apply one removable saddle without flattening the cable.
Inspect all 10 microcoax mates and 10 SMA solder windows.
No rib, stop, screw, adhesive or loose hardware enters a corridor
or its 6-mm connector inspection circle. The 11-mm sandwich
must close with no cable pressure; assembled STEP rechecks this in H6.0.7.
nominal geometry: pass - five clear saddles - minimum relaxed reserve 5.44 mm - H6.0.3 routing is current
